subject: Strange diagonals with plotmatrix for data frames with non-numeric variables

messages.author: 6d1cd0a71e6148df
messages.subject: Strange diagonals with plotmatrix for data frames with non-numeric variables
parts:
Compare the output of

plotmatrix(iris[,1:4])

with the output of

plotmatrix(iris)

The diagonal panels should be identical for the four first variables,
but they aren’t. In the ‘plotmatrix(iris)’ example they show some
strange curves, while in the ‘plotmatrix(iris[,1:4])’ example they
(correctly) show density estimates.

--
Karl Ove Hufthammer
